job.title: Business Development Manager - Water Treatment
job.description:
Business Development Manager – Water Treatment Solutions

Location: UK-wide

Salary: £50,000 – £70,000 basic + 2% bonus on new business

Job Type: Permanent


The Opportunity

Are you a commercially driven Business Development Manager with experience selling technical or engineered solutions into industrial markets?


This is an opportunity to join an established, growing engineering business in the water treatment sector, with more than 30 years' experience designing and manufacturing specialist equipment for the UK market.


The business combines the agility and entrepreneurial culture of an SME with the financial backing and resources of a larger group. Significant investment is being made to support the next phase of growth, including a new purpose-built manufacturing facility.

They are now looking for an ambitious Business Development Manager to play a key role in driving that growth.


This is not simply an account-management position. You will have the opportunity to shape the sales strategy, identify new markets, win new business and help build a scalable commercial operation.


The Role

Reporting to the senior management team, you will own business development across defined markets, build relationships with new and existing customers, and convert opportunities into profitable revenue.


You'll be responsible for:

  • Developing and implementing the company's business development strategy
  • Identifying and winning new business opportunities across industrial and technical markets
  • Growing sales revenue while protecting margins
  • Building relationships with senior decision-makers and key customers
  • Developing new market sectors and identifying opportunities for further growth
  • Understanding customer requirements and helping develop new products and services
  • Working closely with operations and engineering teams on tenders, specifications, proposals and pricing
  • Supporting contract extensions, renewals and commercial negotiations
  • Developing the company's customer and sales database
  • Monitoring competitor activity, market trends, legislation and emerging technologies
  • Positioning the business as a preferred supplier within target markets
  • Working towards and exceeding agreed sales targets


About You

We're looking for someone who is commercially hungry, credible with senior customers and capable of opening doors and winning business.

You'll ideally have:

  • Proven B2B business development or technical sales experience
  • Experience selling engineered, technical or industrial solutions
  • Ideally, knowledge of the water treatment, wastewater or environmental sector
  • Experience selling into manufacturing, process, industrial, healthcare or pharmaceutical environments
  • A strong track record of identifying and converting new business
  • The confidence and gravitas to engage with senior stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • A self-starting, entrepreneurial approach
  • Strong commercial awareness and negotiation skills
  • The ability to manage your own workload, prioritise opportunities and deliver against targets
  • A genuine desire to help build and grow a business


Why Join?

This is a genuine opportunity to join a business at an exciting stage of its development.

You'll have the backing, resources and technical capability of a larger group, while retaining the freedom, influence and entrepreneurial environment you'd expect from a smaller engineering business.

With significant investment being made into the company's facilities, technology and market development, there is plenty of scope for the successful candidate to make their mark and play a major role in the next phase of growth.


Package

  • £50,000 – £70,000 basic salary, depending on experience
  • 2% bonus on new business generated
  • Permanent position
  • UK-based role with travel as required
  • Opportunity to influence and shape the commercial strategy
  • Significant long-term growth opportunity


If you're an ambitious sales professional who wants more than simply managing an existing patch and wants the opportunity to build something and directly influence growth, we'd like to hear from you.


If you don't hear from us within 7 days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

job.title: Water Hygiene Technician
job.description:
Water Hygiene Technician

Location: Slough / Watford area

Salary: £29,000–£35,000 depending on experience

Job Type: Permanent


Hours: Monday to Friday, with overtime and occasional weekend/out-of-hours work available

Are you an experienced Water Hygiene Technician looking for a new opportunity with an established company that will invest in your training and development?


A leading UK provider of water hygiene and compliance services is looking for a Water Hygiene Technician to join its established field-based team, covering the Slough and surrounding areas.


This is a varied role where you will be responsible for carrying out planned preventative maintenance, water monitoring and sampling, TMV servicing, tank cleaning and basic remedial works across a range of commercial and residential sites.


The role

As a Water Hygiene Technician, your responsibilities will include:

  • Carrying out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) work to support effective Legionella control.
  • Monitoring temperatures across hot and cold water systems.
  • Carrying out water sampling for microbiological analysis.
  • Shower cleaning and descaling.
  • Cold water storage tank cleaning and disinfection.
  • Inspecting water systems, including tanks, calorifiers and associated plant.
  • Carrying out TMV inspections and servicing.
  • Undertaking basic remedial plumbing works, including dead-leg removal and TMV replacements.
  • Identifying and reporting potential compliance issues and non-conformances.
  • Providing clear and accurate job reports using a digital compliance system.
  • Liaising professionally with clients and site personnel.
  • Reporting any site issues or remedial requirements to the office.
  • Working closely with the wider team where larger remedial works are required.
  • Ensuring all work is completed in accordance with company procedures, method statements and health and safety requirements.


About you

The successful candidate will have experience within water hygiene, water treatment, Legionella compliance or a related technical environment.

You should have:

  • Good knowledge of hot and cold domestic water systems.
  • Experience carrying out water hygiene PPM work.
  • Experience with temperature monitoring and water sampling.
  • Knowledge of TMVs and water system components.
  • A proactive approach to identifying potential compliance issues.
  • Good communication skills and a professional approach when dealing with clients.
  • The ability to work independently when carrying out PPM visits.
  • A willingness to undertake additional training and develop your technical skills.


A City & Guilds qualification relevant to water hygiene, plumbing qualifications or similar technical certification would be advantageous, but training and development will be provided for the right candidate.

Basic plumbing knowledge would also be beneficial, particularly experience with small remedial works such as dead-leg removal, TMV replacement and expansion vessel configuration.


What you'll get

  • £29,000–£35,000 salary, depending on experience.
  • Permanent Monday-to-Friday position.
  • Company vehicle.
  • Mobile phone.
  • Laptop and required software.
  • All tools and equipment required for the role.
  • Full PPE.
  • Vehicle recovery assistance.
  • Ongoing health and safety training.
  • Full induction and structured training.
  • Access to further external training and industry qualifications.
  • Opportunities to develop your career within the water hygiene and compliance sector.
  • Overtime and weekend work available for those who want to increase their earnings.


The working environment

This is a field-based role and no two days are necessarily the same. You could be carrying out routine PPM and sampling visits one day, then working alongside a remedial team on tank cleaning or other works.

You will generally work within your allocated territory, although occasional travel further afield may be required depending on business needs.

A large proportion of routine PPM work will involve working independently, while larger tank cleaning and remedial projects will generally be completed as part of a team.


The role is predominantly daytime, Monday to Friday, although occasional out-of-hours work may be required. This is currently relatively rare, and there is also the opportunity to undertake additional weekend work and overtime.

Interested?


If you're already working within water hygiene and are looking for a role offering good earning potential, ongoing training and the opportunity to develop your technical skills, we'd be interested in hearing from you.


Apply now for more information.

If you don't hear from us within a week, please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

Job Title

Legionella Risk Assessor | London & South East


Summary Are you an experienced Legionella Risk Assessor looking to join a growing and ambitious water hygiene specialist? Do you want to work for a company that genuinely invests in training, development and career progression?


We're recruiting for a Legionella Risk Assessor to support a portfolio of commercial, public sector and industrial clients across London and the South East. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong technical background in risk assessment who wants to develop their expertise and progress within a growing business.


The Company

• Established specialist in Legionella compliance, water hygiene and water treatment services.

• Strong reputation for delivering high-quality compliance solutions across the UK.

• Growing business with exciting expansion plans and excellent long-term career prospects.

• Supportive and collaborative culture with a focus on employee development.

• Diverse client portfolio spanning commercial, education, industrial and public sector environments.

• Ongoing investment in training, qualifications and professional development.


The Job

• Carry out Legionella Risk Assessments across a variety of client sites throughout London and the South East.

• Assess domestic hot and cold-water systems and other water systems in line with current legislation and guidance.

• Produce clear, detailed and technically robust risk assessment reports.

• Identify compliance issues and provide practical recommendations for remedial actions and risk reduction.

• Create and update schematic drawings to accurately reflect water system layouts.

• Build strong working relationships with clients, explaining findings and recommendations clearly and professionally.

• Manage your own diary and workload, travelling between sites while maintaining high standards of service delivery.

The Ideal Candidate

• Previous experience as a Legionella Risk Assessor or within the water hygiene industry.

• City & Guilds Legionella Risk Assessment qualification or equivalent.

• Good working knowledge of ACOP L8 and HSG274 guidance.

• Experience producing or interpreting schematic drawings of water systems.

• Understanding of domestic hot and cold-water systems; experience with cooling towers or other water systems would be advantageous.

• Excellent report writing and communication skills.

• Self-motivated, organised and capable of working independently.

• Full UK driving licence.

• Based within approximately one hour of Central London.


Particularly Interested In Candidates With:

• 2+ years' Legionella Risk Assessment experience.

• Strong knowledge of HSG274 Parts 1, 2 and/or 3.

• Experience assessing cooling towers, process water systems, water features or other specialist systems.

• Understanding of HTM 04-01 guidance (advantageous but not essential).

• Ongoing training, qualifications and career development opportunities.
